S.O. N.I.C.E. begins by understanding the situation and spotting an opportunity to improve it. Then it keeps the user and the evidence in view from needs through the next version.

![The S.O. N.I.C.E. plant cycle grows from a situation and opportunity through Needs, Inquiry and Investigation, Create and Communicate, and Evaluate before repeating.](../../assets/nice-design-process/nice-process-cycle.png){#fig-nice-process fig-alt="A plant grows from Situation and Opportunity at its roots into a repeating N.I.C.E. cycle: Needs, Inquiry and Investigation, Create and Communicate, and Evaluate."}
